data.narrative:
Radian Forge is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $3M+ to date. The comp universe consists of 8 private peers in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics, alongside 1 public comparable (277810.KQ).

Stage-progression methodology is applicable and anchors the valuation. Using the $3M total raised as a proxy for seed-stage valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields $7.5M. Peer-median valuation is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparable data; while 8 same-sector peers exist, none qualify within same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier filters. Relying on broader-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise given the limited overlap in company maturity and capital structure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M (low) to $9M (high), with a median of $8M. This range reflects application of a single reliable method. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x multiplier for this specific company's market position and near-term funding trajectory, and the absence of direct peer-stage comparables to validate or adjust the step-up assumption. Additional data on prior seed-round pricing or more granular stage-definition among robotics peers would strengthen conviction in this range.
